title: Tidy up the test suite
body: Many older tests use legacy fixtures instead of `datasette.client`, duplicate one another, or are slow. Clean the suite up.
reference: **Direct swap to `ds_client`.** Tests that use plain `app_client` for HTTP: `test_logout` and the create-token tests in `test_auth.py`, the three legacy-csrftoken tests in `test_csrf_middleware.py`, the column-statistics tests in `test_html.py` and `test_table_html.py`, and `test_permissions_checked`.
**Only need a `Datasette` object.** Eight tests and the `db` fixture in `test_internals_database.py` take `app_client` just for `.ds`.

**Custom settings or config only.** Most of the ~70 `make_app_client(settings=...)` / `config=...` calls. These want an async factory fixture that mirrors `ds_client` in `conftest.py` (in-memory fixtures database plus keyword overrides). That costs about 60ms and touches no disk.
**Need a real file.** Immutable databases, `inspect_data`, the dotted filename, `extra_databases`, crossdb and database download. These stay on disk but can make requests through `client.ds.client`.

`make_app_client()` calls `os.chdir()` into a temporary directory that is deleted when the context manager exits, leaving the process in a directory that no longer exists. Moving tests off `make_app_client()` (section 1) reduces exposure; the `chdir` itself may be removable.
`app_client_returned_rows_matches_page_size` in `tests/fixtures.py` appears to be unused and can be deleted.
`test_sql_time_limit` in both `test_api.py` and `test_html.py` runs `select sleep(0.5)` against a 20ms time limit. A shorter sleep would save about a second across the two.
`test_tracer.py` builds a fresh `trace_debug=True` client in three separate tests; they could share one fixture.

`conftest.py` uses `move_to_front()` to force some tests to run first. The plugin-leak fix removed one reason `test_plugins_cli` depended on ordering; it would be worth checking whether any of the `move_to_front()` entries are still needed.
